name: Corum Integration
description: Displays Corum map data, previews record points, and submits records with locally staged clear verification data and a startup snapshot of loaded mods.

show-rating.name: Show Corum difficulty
show-rating.description: Uses the map catalog loaded once at startup to show a color-coded Corum rating card, current rank, and maximum points.

enable-record-submit.name: Record submission
enable-record-submit.description: Shows Corum record controls. Completed Corum clears are staged locally and any pending verification data is sent only when you press Submit or Submit All.

submit-notifications.name: Record notifications
submit-notifications.description: Also shows a notification after the submission popup reports success or failure.
